cefrAlignment: Fits B1: finding and passing on straightforward factual information from a simple schedule, with polite corrections, in short, concrete spoken turns.
examFidelity: Matches exams.ts and ETS: 45 s reading, about 3 s prep, 15/15/30 s answers, questions heard and not read; I checked every model answer and MCQ against both schedule tables, and all times, rooms, names, prices and notes are exact.
openConcerns: The question text is also printed in each speak prompt, so learners can read it although the instructions say the real test is audio only; this is a limitation of the player
learnerOutcome: Can scan a schedule in 45 seconds and answer detail, correction and list questions in full, polite spoken sentences, without reading the table aloud.
